facts.fact: Tech Africa describes Raxio DRC as the carrier-neutral operator's Kinshasa facility, where KINIX has installed its exchange infrastructure.
Tech Africa says Raxio DRC holds Tier III certification from the Uptime Institute.
Tech Africa says KINIX, founded in 2012, carries 23 participating networks across 25 connections, including all four major mobile operators.
Tech Africa says Meta and Cloudflare both peer at KINIX.
KINIX says it currently exchanges more than 1 terabit per second and expects to pass 2 Tbps after the Raxio deployment.

Tech Africa says networks registered outside the DRC peer at KINIX, including GVA in Cote d'Ivoire, Paratus and AFR-IX Telecom, and that exchange points in Goma and Lubumbashi serve the east and south.

systems.country_label: distributed exchange across Kinshasa sites, launched May 2026
